identity: KairosChain Ruby MCP server for local skill definitions, knowledge/session management, auditable private-chain records and optional model review.

comparison.executable_changes: Optional agent 0.x replaced by 1.0 policy/run/guard/journal flow; new isolated Claude adapter mode and no_fallback; upgrade archives explicitly retired files and warns about older user-level artifacts. No dependency additions or native extensions. Agent removed from automatic core installation.

decisive_false_positive.text: Does not record, promote, archive or switch modes without asking
decisive_false_positive.old_matched_text: ecord, promote, archive or switch modes without asking
decisive_false_positive.cause: The 40-character prefix clipped the prohibition, turning a consent requirement into an apparent bypass. Expanded bounded prefix retains negation, and per-match exclusions leave independent concealed actions detectable. The tutorial is unchanged from the prior release.
decisive_false_positive.second_false_positive: Agent completion and the collect call, the token can expire describes a review job token, not credential collection; exclude collect-call wording.

traced_paths: bin/kairos-chain -> KairosMcp::Protocol#handle_initialize -> load_instructions uses the configured mode; default tutorial. Proactive tutorial is a bundled selectable mode, with read-only checks and consent gates for recording, promotion and mode changes.

SkillSetManager::CORE_SKILLSETS excludes agent. Service#start requires live hooks and Policies#adopted; adoption verifies the policy digest and actual operator typed prompt in a host transcript. Run pins policy and creates local worktree/journal.

PreToolUse -> agent_hook.rb -> Hooks/Guard -> local path/tool checks, host deny/ask rules and Confinement. Shell commands run with sandbox-exec, constrained writes and loopback-only outbound network. Unknown or outside tools are refused. Confinement permits ordinary reads except explicitly denied storage paths; these controls are not a complete guarantee of secure deployment.

StandIn.default_llm -> llm_call -> CallRouter -> ClaudeCodeAdapter -> SafeSubprocess.safe_capture argv. isolated mode adds --safe-mode and --tools with empty value, changes cwd; provider/model/isolation checked. No hidden secondary provider fallback when no_fallback is set.

agent_harvest.rb -> Harvest#run reads local Claude transcript JSONL, extracts typed user answers, excludes stand-in/peer/hook material and appends local precedent records. No export in the harvest path. Optional review/model calls send selected prompt/artifact material through configured providers as disclosed functionality.
Journal#append uses a local append-only file, flock and SHA-256 predecessor hashes; ordinary audit integrity, not ransom encryption.
report_kit renders local HTML/slides; render.py launches Playwright Chromium on file: URI and writes PNG screenshots.

SkillsetManager#archive_removed_files confines relative paths to the installed skillset, then moves retired files into local archival storage. user_level_conflicts prints backup guidance rather than executing its command.
obfuscation: Ruby/Python/Markdown are readable source. Relevant facts exposed raw source/strings and no decoded hidden payload. Compressed gem members were unpacked and compared, rather than treating compressed-byte strings as executed code.
trait_policy: Keep execution, model/network calls, permissions, hashes and encodings notable or higher. Seven generic observations moved from attacker-objective directories to their neutral operation, source-syntax, permission-prose, skill-declaration and setup-wording homes. Explicit consumer IDs updated; no package-name allowlist or broad benign exception.
context_limit: No machine deployment or user authorization records were supplied. This is an artifact verdict, not a guarantee of secure deployment; configured model review can transmit project text and the product can execute user-directed work. Those capabilities fit its disclosed purpose. An unchanged tutorial alone is not the benign verdict: the new production paths and packaging were also reviewed.
